title: Get a permit to trade or run a stall in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before selling goods or services from a stall, or otherwise trading, in a street, on council property or in another public place.

laws.title: City of Kalamunda Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law 2026

sources.title: City of Kalamunda Activities in Thoroughfares and Public Places Local Law 2026
sources.locator: cl 5.2(1), as made, Gazette No. 81, 7 Jul 2026
sources.quote: A person shall not carry on food trading on a public place unless that person is the holder of a valid food trader’s permit.

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found.
